articleTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy
imageHeadline: Bleeding on birth control doesn't always mean it's working
imageSubtext: How to tell if breakthrough bleeding is normal or a sign of pregnancy
pinTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy | Hormones
pinDescription: Breakthrough bleeding is common on hormonal birth control, but it can be hard to know what's normal. Learn the difference between expected side effects and signs that might indicate pregnancy, so you know when to take a test or call your provider.
